findings.description: Sit/crouch renders still show both shorts thighs exposed and the apron hanging behind or between the legs. Wider hem material accumulates in curled side layers; hash-bound coverage improved only marginally and remains far below adequate coverage.

Direct inspection of V26 images shows the wider silhouette has ladder-like triangular side creases, stacked hem edges, projecting corners, and persistent coarse faceting; surface continuity regressed from V25.
The rear adjustment tab still blends into the jacket and the buckle has no distinct readable shape in the current back view.
Authored UV mapping is still missing. The mesh topology illustration is not a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V26 manually widened six overskirt hem contours by 29.4% while keeping waist edges, length, forward projection, fold field, and thigh weights fixed. Direct inspection of five current views and six poses, plus hash-bound pose coverage, shows only marginal sit/crouch upper-thigh gains (2.1–2.8 percentage points); both shorts thighs remain exposed. The wider hem creates an uneven flared side silhouette and does not resolve coarse faceting. Rear-tab legibility and authored UVs remain unresolved; no fit or appearance acceptance is granted.

nextAction: REJECT. Do not repeat hem widening or add length/forward projection. Replace the seated lap panel deformation/attachment with a continuous overlap across both raised thighs and resolve its side-to-front transition; validate with actual posed coverage. Improve skirt surface continuity, separate rear tab/buckle geometry and material, and author/verify UVs. Rebuild a new targeted revision and directly inspect five views and six poses; fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package and release remain unverified.
